records.text: New York Giants won the 1956 NFL Championship, beating Chicago Bears 47–7.
records.textJa: New York Giantsが1956年のNFL選手権でChicago Bearsに47対7で勝った。

records.highlight: four-time Larry O'Brien Championship Trophy winner
records.text: LeBron James, the Cleveland Cavaliers power forward and four-time Larry O'Brien Championship Trophy winner, was born on this day in 1984.
records.textJa: LeBron James（Cleveland Cavaliersのパワーフォワード、four-time Larry O'Brien Championship Trophy winner）は1984年のこの日に生まれた。

records.text: Jearld Baylis, the Toronto Argonauts defensive lineman and Grey Cup winner, died on this day in 2024, aged 62.
records.textJa: Jearld Baylis（Toronto Argonautsのディフェンスライン、Grey Cup winner）が2024年のこの日に62歳で死去した。

records.highlight: Hockey Hall of Famer with a Stanley Cup title
records.text: Charlie Gardiner, the Chicago Blackhawks goaltender and Hockey Hall of Famer with a Stanley Cup title, was born on this day in 1904 (died 1934).
records.textJa: Charlie Gardiner（Chicago Blackhawksのゴールテンダー、Hockey Hall of Famer with a Stanley Cup title）は1904年のこの日に生まれた（1934年死去）。

records.text: Green Bay Packers won the 1961 NFL Championship, beating New York Giants 37–0.
records.textJa: Green Bay Packersが1961年のNFL選手権でNew York Giantsに37対0で勝った。

records.text: Oakland Raiders won the 1967 AFL Championship, beating Houston Oilers 40–7.
records.textJa: Oakland Raidersが1967年のAFL選手権でHouston Oilersに40対7で勝った。

records.personAward: Major League Baseball Most Valuable Player Award
records.text: Roberto Clemente, the Pittsburgh Pirates right fielder and two-time World Series winner, died on this day in 1972, aged 38.
records.textJa: Roberto Clemente（Pittsburgh Piratesの右翼手、two-time World Series winner）が1972年のこの日に38歳で死去した。

records.text: Jakob Schubert, Austrian rock climber, was born on this day in 1990.
records.textJa: Jakob Schubert（Austrian rock climber）は1990年のこの日に生まれた。
